messages:
maya (AE): Heads-up — ACME POC is blocked on tracing & logs correlation. They see 429s on streaming and the logs have no trace_id. POC ends Friday so this is urgent. Can we swarm?

jordan (SE): On it. Are they on Hosted or Dedicated? Can you paste one failing request/response?

maya (AE): Hosted. Sample response from the client:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  \"error\": \"Rate limit exceeded\",
  \"code\": 429,
  \"retry_after\": 15,
  \"request_id\": null
}
```
Logs show `request_id` sometimes but often null — no consistent trace id. They've tried setting `X-Request-ID: abc123` but it doesn't show up in our console.

devin (SRE): Two quick options:
1) Enable server-side trace injection for the org (Console -> Project Settings -> Logging -> Enable `inject_trace_id`). That will add `trace_id` to every log event.
2) Ask the client to send `X-Redwood-Trace: <uuid>` on each request — we echo that header back and include it in logs so they can correlate.
Example curl to demonstrate header echo:
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
     -H \"X-Redwood-Trace: 01cdef89-7a6b\" \\
     -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-x\",\"input\":\"hello\"}' \\
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response will include something like: `{ \"trace_id\": \"01cdef89-7a6b\", \"request_id\": \"rq_123\" }`

jordan (SE): If they can't modify the client quickly we can try session-level mapping, but quicker is to ask them to add the header. Also they hit rate limits — @devin can you do a temporary quota bump for the POC org? :pray: 

devin (SRE): Done — I bumped ACME-PoC org tokens/min to 50k for POC until Fri 23:59 UTC and enabled debug-level logs for 24h. You should start seeing `trace_id` fields show up. :thumbsup:

maya (AE): I can already see trace_id in Console: `tr_9a1b2c3d`. Next ask from ACME SRE: they want a full export of traces (timestamps + prompt + response tokens) to ingest into their observability pipeline. How do we get them a JSON/CSV export?

devin (SRE): Two ways:
- From Console: Project -> Logs -> Add filter `org:acme-poc` and `trace_id:tr_9a1b2c3d`, then Export -> choose JSONL (each line is a JSON event).
- Or programmatic export: POST to `https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/exports` with body e.g.
```
{
  \"filter\": \"org:acme-poc\",
  \"format\": \"jsonl\",
  \"destination\": \"s3://acme-poc-logs\",
  \"kms\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd\",
  \"redact_fields\": []
}
```
Note: We need the bucket ARN and an IAM role that allows writes. I can kick off the export once we have the bucket + role.

lucas (PM): I'll coordinate with ACME SRE for the S3 bucket and IAM role. Quick question — by default do exports include prompt/response content? We need to confirm privacy expectations.

devin (SRE): For POC orgs we include full payloads by default so they get prompt/response. If they require redaction we can add `redact_fields: [\"prompt\",\"response\"]` in the export body and we'll remove those fields from the exported events. Example with redaction: 
```
{
  \"filter\":\"org:acme-poc\",
  \"format\":\"jsonl\",
  \"destination\":\"s3://acme-poc-logs\",
  \"redact_fields\":[\"prompt\",\"response\"]
}
```

maya (AE): Great. I'm DMing ACME SRE now to request bucket + confirm redaction. If we still see 429 after the bump, what's our escalation path?

devin (SRE): I'll keep an eye on the org. If rate limits recur I'll open an incident and we can bring on-call SRE. Also note: we push a small SDK change today so that if `X-Redwood-Trace` is present we will echo it verbatim as `trace_id` in the response body to make client correlation trivial. Patch scheduled for deployment this afternoon.

jordan (SE): I'll be on the call with ACME at 14:30 PT. If anyone wants to join let me know.

ops-bot: Temporary quota change applied to org `acme-poc` by devin at 2024-11-20T18:10:00Z (tokens/min=50000, debug_logs=true for 24h).

maya (AE): Thanks team — this seems like a good plan. I'll update ACME and loop back once I have bucket details. :sparkles:
